theme: 吉伊卡哇 · 小小冒险队

light.method: 内置 image_gen AI 绘画
light.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an exquisite original scene composition starring the three referenced Chiikawa characters: white round Chiikawa with round ears, blue-and-white Hachiware with pointed blue ears and center-parted head pattern, pale yellow Usagi with long upright pink-lined ears. Preserve their recognizable tiny proportions, expressive eyes, black hand-drawn contours and pink cheeks exactly. They are camping together beside a small cream and coral tent, sharing a simple picnic, one holding a little plain cup, one offering a snack, Usagi excitedly pointing at a butterfly. Hand-drawn 2D gouache and soft watercolor storybook environment, NOT 3D plush. Bright clean spring grass, tiny daisies, soft sky-blue distance and cotton clouds. Premium restrained illustration, tactile paint, joyful composition. Wide landscape 16:9 target 3840x2160. All three characters clearly full-body within right x=53%-94%, feet above y=83%, with comfortable breathing room; left 43% calm pale sky and grass with sparse detail reserved for later real UI. Main characters fill right half strongly, not tiny distant figures. Balanced foreground/middle/distant depth, all faces visible. Reference images are character identity only: do not copy reference lettering or layout. NO typography, logos, watermark, software windows, UI controls, buttons, signs with text.

Replace daylight atmosphere with luminous dusky blue and muted violet landscape, a few gentle stars, tent glowing softly amber from within and a small warm camping lantern near the picnic basket. Warm local light on cheeks and hands, cool indigo shadows in grass. Retain light character body colors rather than tinting faces heavily purple.
